svg.text: Infrastructure conversion with application behavior preserved
Linux host for Laravel, workers and scheduler
Secrets and certificates; access via managed identity
Object storage for documents and media
Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server
Retain the MySQL engine; not Azure SQL Database
Build from GitHub, push images and deploy
Retain existing models; select GPU/memory after sizing
Azure Managed Disks on AI VM
Persistent storage; Blob Storage is not the live vector DB
• Laravel, Inertia.js, Fortify and Sanctum remain application components.
• GitHub and SMS / WhatsApp / Expo / Meta remain external integrations.
• Laravel owns relational SQL writes; the AI service uses ChromaDB and SQLite.
• Mount persistent managed disks for the AI data paths. Choose VM SKU/region after memory and GPU sizing.
• Blob Storage needs a compatible Laravel filesystem adapter or SDK integration. Key Vault needs identity/access configuration.
• This is a proposed architecture drawing, not a deployed or fully configured Azure environment.
